svg.title: CHRONA — Color Palette & Surface Elevation System
svg.desc: AMOLED pitch-black surfaces, deep blue-gray elevation, light theme tokens, periwinkle accent, and 8 timezone identity colors.

g.text: True AMOLED #000000 canvas · Distinct blue-gray card surfaces · Independent periwinkle UI & 8 pastel timezone accents
A. AMOLED Dark Surfaces (Pitch-Black Base + Blue-Gray Elevation)
D. Main Application Accent (Periwinkle Slate) & Semantic States
E. 8 Persistent Timezone Identity Colors (Isolated from Main UI Accent)
Assigned deterministically to saved cities for 4dp card identity strips, world map pins, and comparison timeline markers.
